inputs.name: createDeploymentsStore.workspace
inputs.description: A Workspace instance whose project, snapshot, activity, deployment bridge, and busy state the store reads while operating. It is required when constructing the store.

outputs.name: createDeploymentsStore
outputs.description: A DeploymentsState instance bound to the supplied workspace, exposing environment selection, status refresh, deployment review and execution, and related loading and error state. The factory returns this class instance.
